Immutable host policy authorizes generic mappings and ordered fallback names. Authored candidates precede host fallback. CSS style/weight selection uses directional weight phases, including 400-500; literal constructor requests keep nearest weight and deterministic ties.

SVG preparation requests emitted normalized scalars and lazily acquires later covering programs. Primary ownership is preserved; same-SHA programs are shared, conflicting declarations reject and unsupported selected faces fail before provider access.

Request-only preparation has no scalar coverage and selects one candidate. Raw conversion consults supplied snapshot requests only. Supplementary scalar indices/units per em and face boundaries remain explicit; no cross-face kerning or ligature merge is introduced.
